facts.label: Dicas contadas com told
facts.sub: She told us about the beach. She told me that the sand was soft. She said that it was far. Told leva pessoa; said não.

facts.label: Told + pessoa
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa: She told me, she told us, he told them. Depois vem that ou about: She told us about the beach. She told me that the sand was soft.

facts.label: Said + that
facts.sub: Use said sem pessoa: She said that it was far. Se a pessoa aparecer, use told: She told us. Não diga said us. Nas duas, o verbo costuma ir para o passado.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Told is followed by a person: told us.
We say “She said us that the beach was nice”.
items.why: We say She told us that… or She said that…

items.s: The verb often moves to the past in reported speech.

answers: Told is followed by a person: told us. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She said us that the beach was nice”. → Falso (We say She told us that… or She said that…)

pages.title: Beach tips from a local guide in Bristol · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Friday morning in Bristol. Ada and Rui walk along the old harbour. Yesterday they joined a short tour with a local guide. The guide gave them many tips about the area. Now they try to remember everything she said. They want to find the best beach for the weekend.

“Rui, a local guide told us about the best beach near Bristol.” says Ada. “Really? What did she say about it? Is it far from the harbour?” says Rui. “She said that it was only an hour by bus, and she told me that the sand was soft.” says Ada.
